about: 9:16 safe-zone presets used by `social.py`. Margins are fractions of the frame (top, bottom, left, right). They come from third-party summaries of the platforms' own templates; the official pages could not be fetched when this file was written. Platforms change their UI overlays: check the current official template (TikTok Ads Manager safe-zone templates, Meta Ads Manager safe-zone guardrail) before relying on a number.

tiktok_in_feed.label: TikTok in-feed (standard layout)
tiktok_in_feed.source: https://admanage.ai/blog/tiktok-ad-specs (third-party: 108/320 px of 1920, 60/120 px of 1080); TikTok publishes several templates, not one universal zone
